setup.text: One old tree remains near the village as fuel runs short.

choices.label: Protect it and gather fallen branches.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The village stays warm through the storm.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The loss of shade damages nearby seedlings.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The tree survives, but fuel remains scarce.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The charm warms the hall for one night.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The charm fails, and the families share blankets.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Less fuel is needed for cooking.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The new hearth takes time and materials to finish.

b2__fx.name: Outcome B2
b2__fx.text: The villagers discover a reliable source of deadwood.
